name.ja: Figure-rise Standard Amplified メタルガルルモン

description.ja: 『デジモンアドベンチャー』より「メタルガルルモン」がFigure-rise Standard Amplifiedシリーズに登場！
description.en: "Metal Garurumon " from " Digimon Adventure" appears in the Figure-rise Standard Amplified series!

description.ja: • As'まりあ氏のプラモデル用描き起こしイラストを公式監修のもと立体化。
description.en: • The original illustration drawn by As'Maria for the plastic model has been made into three-dimensional under official supervision.

description.ja: • 色分けを含む細部までこだわったパーツ分割により満足度の高い組みごたえを体感できる。
description.en: • You can experience a highly satisfying assembly experience by dividing parts with attention to detail, including color coding.

description.ja: • 圧倒的な可動域を誇る各部ギミックにより、メタルガルルモンの特徴的なポージングが演出可能。
description.en: • Each part's gimmick boasts an overwhelming range of motion, allowing you to create Metal Garurumon's distinctive poses.

description.ja: • 胴体は柔軟に可動し、獣らしい姿勢を再現。
description.en: • The body can move flexibly, reproducing the posture of a beast.

description.ja: • 前足の付け根は広範囲な可動でポーズを自然に演出。
description.en: • The base of the front legs can be moved over a wide range to create natural poses.

description.ja: • 開口する際に上顎が下へスライドすることで自然な顎の開閉を実現。
description.en: • The upper jaw slides downward when opening the mouth, allowing the jaw to open and close naturally.

description.ja: • ジョイントパーツで新たな武装形態を実現。必殺技エフェクトはクリアパーツで付属。
description.en: • Realize new weapon forms with joint parts. Special move effects are included as clear parts.

description.ja: • ビームウィングのギミック等、プラモデルオリジナルの無限大の楽しみ方を提案。
description.en: • We offer infinite ways to enjoy original plastic models such as beam wing gimmicks.

description.ja: • 付属のアクションベースと組み合わせてより躍動感のあるポージングが可能。
description.en: • You can create more dynamic poses by combining it with the included action base.
